== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Wolf{{!}}The Wolf Division is a specialized branch of the [[Abidan]] composed of highly skilled combatants. Led by [[Razael]], also known as the [[Wolf]], the division focuses on honing their bodies through Way{{!}}the Way to become efficient instruments of war. The group possesses numerous destructive capabilities that are not part of the public record, and its members have demonstrated the ability to hold their own against warriors capable of leveling mountains. While they are noted for their combat prowess, the division has also suffered significant losses in major conflicts; one historical battle resulted in the deaths of four hundred members and led to the capture of an [[Iteration]]. The division maintains a sense of disdain for the [[Reaper Division]] and is considered one of the [[Abidan]]'s greatest assets. Recruits undergo training in large compounds consisting of multiple floors of identical pods, and the division has recently seen new talent arriving from various worlds.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As one of the combat-oriented divisions of the [[Abidan]], the [[Wolf]] Division serves as a specialized military force. The division operates out of a training compound that houses hundreds of recruits. Within this facility, the group utilizes a device capable of materializing items. Despite their martial nature, individuals such as [[Jek’nan]] have no reason to fear the division.}}
